slides.title: DUP Market Radar
slides.subtitle: Hybrid Python + Rust real-time crypto market watchlist
slides.voice_text: DUP Market Radar is a hybrid Python and Rust watchlist built for the crypto market. It tracks spot, watch-only futures, memes, stablecoins, and new listings. Manual orders and optional auto-execution run strictly on KuCoin spot.

bullets.title: Repeatable

slides.voice_text: This clip is recorded from a scenario file. It types a symbol, clicks search, zooms in on the result, and scrolls the page. Every step is written to a timeline.
